# DefectDojo Documentation

> Official documentation for DefectDojo, a vulnerability management and application security posture management (ASPM) platform. It covers the free, open-source Community Edition and DefectDojo Pro, the commercial edition.

Key facts:

- DefectDojo is an OWASP Flagship Project. Community Edition is free under the BSD 3-Clause license and is self-hosted. DefectDojo Pro runs as a managed cloud service or self-hosted, including in air-gapped networks.
- DefectDojo does not scan. It imports findings from 500+ security tools by file import, API or connector, and normalizes them into one data model of Assets, Engagements, Tests and Findings.
- It deduplicates findings within a tool, across tools and across reimports, as described in https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_deduplication/deduplication_across_tools/
- The remaining findings are tracked through remediation with SLAs, risk acceptance, reimports that close fixed findings, and ticketing integrations such as Jira.
- DefectDojo Sensei is the AI layer in DefectDojo Pro.
- Company website: https://defectdojo.com (its own llms.txt is https://defectdojo.com/llms.txt). Source code: https://github.com/DefectDojo/django-DefectDojo

## Triage Findings

- [Introduction to Findings](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/findings_workflows/intro_to_findings/): The main workflow and vulnerability tracking system of DefectDojo
- [Creating Findings Manually](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/findings_workflows/create_findings_manually/): Track vulnerability information without using a scan tool
- [Editing Findings](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/findings_workflows/editing_findings/): Change a Finding’s Status, or add more metadata as you resolve an issue
- [Finding Status Definitions](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/findings_workflows/finding_status_definitions/): A quick reference to Finding status: Open, Verified, Accepted..
- [Risk Acceptances (Open Source)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/findings_workflows/os__risk_acceptance/): Leveraging Risk Acceptances in DefectDojo OS
- [Risk Acceptances (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/findings_workflows/pro__risk_acceptance/): Leveraging Risk Acceptances in DefectDojo Pro
- [Attaching Files (Open Source)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/findings_workflows/os__add_files/): Upload screenshots, reports, or other supporting files to a Finding, Engagement, or Test in DefectDojo OS
- [Attaching Files (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/findings_workflows/pro__add_files/): Upload screenshots, reports, or other supporting files to a Finding, Engagement, or Test in DefectDojo Pro
- [Bulk Editing Findings (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/findings_workflows/pro__bulk_edit_findings/): Apply metadata changes, tags, notes, and review to many Findings at once in the DefectDojo Pro UI
- [Mitigation Policies (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/findings_workflows/pro__mitigation_policy/): Standardize how Findings should be remediated with reusable, centrally managed Mitigation Policies
- [AI Governance Policies (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/findings_workflows/pro__ai_governance_policies/): Decide which AI components are authorized where, and turn unauthorized ones into Findings
- [Export Findings (Open Source)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/findings_workflows/exporting/): Export findings and engagements as CSV or Excel
- [Peer Review & Claiming (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/findings_workflows/pro__peer_review/): Request a review from specific people, claim a review so others know it is being handled, and control who is eligible to be asked
- [How DefectDojo Deduplicates Findings Across Security Tools](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_deduplication/deduplication_across_tools/): DefectDojo does not scan. It imports findings from 500+ security tools, normalizes them, and deduplicates them within a tool, across tools and across reimports, so each vulnerability reaches remediation as one active Finding.
- [About Deduplication](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_deduplication/about_deduplication/): Deduplication fundamentals and key concepts
- [Enabling Deduplication (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_deduplication/pro_enabling_product_deduplication/): How to enable Deduplication at the Asset or Engagement level
- [Similar Findings (Open Source)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_deduplication/os__similar_findings/): Find related Findings on the View Finding page and manually link them as duplicates
- [Similar Findings (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_deduplication/pro__similar_findings/): Find related Findings on the View Finding page and manually link them as duplicates
- [Avoiding Excess Duplicates](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_deduplication/avoid_excess_duplicates/)
- [Deduplication Tuning (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_deduplication/pro__deduplication_tuning/): Configure how DefectDojo identifies and manages duplicate findings
- [Deduplication Tuning (Open Source)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_deduplication/os__deduplication_tuning/): Configure deduplication in DefectDojo Open Source: algorithms, hash fields, endpoints, and service
- [Global Component Deduplication (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_deduplication/pro__global_component_deduplication/): Deduplicate Software Composition Analysis Findings by component name and version across all Assets
- [Global Locations Deduplication (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_deduplication/pro__global_locations_deduplication/): Deduplicate Findings by shared location (URL or dependency) across all Assets
- [Location Drift Matching (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_deduplication/pro__location_drift_matching/): Track findings as their locations change across reimports: line shifts, file renames, URL moves, and dependency version bumps no longer close and recreate findings
- [False Positive History](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_deduplication/false_positive_history/): Automatically mark new Findings as false positive when a matching Finding was already triaged that way
- [Dedupe Pools (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_deduplication/pro__dedupe_pools/): Group Assets so their Findings deduplicate against each other, per matching kind
- [Root Cause Correlation (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_correlation/pro__root_cause_correlation/): Group Findings that share a root cause -- the same vulnerable component, CVE, infrastructure resource, or weakness at a URL -- so one fix can be traced to every Finding it resolves
- [CVSS Version Support](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_scoring/cvss_support/): Which CVSS versions DefectDojo stores, displays, and accepts on Findings
- [EPSS / KEV (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_scoring/epss_kev/): How DefectDojo Pro enriches Findings with EPSS and CISA KEV data, when it syncs, and how it drives priority
- [Reachability (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_scoring/reachability/): How DefectDojo Pro records whether a Finding's vulnerable code is actually reachable, and how that verdict adjusts priority
- [Asset Exposure (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/triage_findings/finding_scoring/asset_exposure/): How DefectDojo Pro records whether an asset is reachable from outside, whether a Finding is deployed in production, and how both adjust priority

## Connectors

- [Messaging Connectors (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/issue_tracking/pro_integration/messaging_connectors/): Send alerts from DefectDojo to Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, or Amazon SNS.

## Metrics and Reports

- [AI Agent Red Teaming (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/sensei/ai_agent_redteam/): Onboard a deployed AI agent, attack it automatically to find where it breaks, and vet an agent's actions at runtime

- [Dynamic Scanning (DAST) (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/sensei/dynamic_scanning/): Point dynamic scans at a deployed environment of a repository Sensei already knows, once you have proven you own the domain.

- [Feed Findings](https://docs.defectdojo.com/psirt/feed-findings/): Triage incoming advisories and read the tri-state answer to 'am I affected?'
- [Cases and SLA](https://docs.defectdojo.com/psirt/cases/): Group matches into work items, and track the triage obligation on them
- [Advisories](https://docs.defectdojo.com/psirt/advisories/): Write, review, publish and revise your own security advisories
- [PSIRT dashboard](https://docs.defectdojo.com/psirt/dashboard/): A shared dashboard template that answers "am I affected?" first
- [SLA Policies](https://docs.defectdojo.com/psirt/sla-policies/): Tune how long each severity tier gets before a PSIRT clock warns and breaches
- [PSIRT Settings](https://docs.defectdojo.com/psirt/settings/): Case-worthiness calibration, the "new" item window, and what counts as a material change
- [CRA Article 14 Reporting (Pro)](https://docs.defectdojo.com/psirt/cra-article14-reporting/): Track the 24 hour, 72 hour and final report deadlines the Cyber Resilience Act sets for an actively exploited vulnerability or a severe incident

## Optional

- [Open Source Upgrading](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/upgrading_guide/): Release specific upgrading instructions
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.4.100](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/3.4.100/): The deprecated Tool Type, Tool Configuration, and API Scan Configuration API endpoints send a corrected end-of-life date and a single-sentence Classic UI warning.
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.5.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/3.5/): No special instructions.
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.3.200](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/3.3.200/): In DefectDojo Pro, a restart now applies the Locations and Organization / Asset Relabeling toggles to the Classic UI and the /api/v2 route wiring. Those surfaces used to keep following the deployment environment variables no matter what the Feature Flags page said.
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.4.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/3.4/): No special instructions.
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.2.200](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/3.2.200/): DefectDojo Pro can now enable Locations as a self-service, database-backed toggle on the Feature Flags page, and carry existing history forward with an in-app data-migration suite that backfills endpoint, dependency, and source-code locations before an identity rehash.
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.2.100](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/3.2.100/): Notes marked private are now visible only to their author and to superusers.
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.3.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/3.3/): Three parsers gain deduplication registrations, which changes the stored identity of their findings. Xeol Parser moves off the legacy hash so its identity stops depending on the wall clock; Checkmarx One Scan hashes the vendor id it already matches on; Checkmarx Scan detailed gains the same field list as its CxFlow sibling. Instances with the identity signature ledger enabled bridge these changes automatically; others should rehash the affected scan types after upgrading. Separately, SARIF-family parsers stop trusting fingerprints that repeat within a report, which stops unrelated findings from being merged; no rehash is needed for that change.
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.2.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/3.2/): Vulnerability ids gain an autodetected type and a uniqueness constraint; findings can now carry multiple CWEs via a new Finding_CWE relationship. Migrations add the type column, de-duplicate vulnerability-id rows, add the uniqueness constraint, create the CWE table, and backfill it. The vulnerability id and CWE changes leave existing hash codes untouched; four split deduplication registrations are repaired, which changes the identity of Burp Suite DAST Scan findings, and the AWS Security Hub parser now sorts resource IDs, which is an identity change for findings that report more than one resource. The locations ingredient of the hash code is now sorted on both code paths, an identity change for multi-endpoint findings on installs running with DD_V3_FEATURE_LOCATIONS=False, and recomputing the hash code of a saved finding that has locations no longer raises an error. This release also deprecates the API-based (pull) parsers, the Tool Type / Tool Configuration feature, and the django-dbbackup integration, all scheduled for removal in 3.5.0.
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.0.200](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/3.0.200/): Xygeni parser keys SAST/Secrets deduplication on uniqueHash; repeated secrets are aggregated into one finding.
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.0.100](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/3.0.100/): Xygeni parser keeps repeated SAST/Secrets occurrences in the same file as distinct findings.
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.1.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/3.1/): Blank Finding components are now normalized to NULL so component-less findings group together; JIRA project configurations now support multiple comma-separated components; Tool Configuration credentials are re-encrypted to AES-256-GCM; the JFrog Xray API Summary Artifact parser now sorts impact paths so findings deduplicate consistently across re-imports; a new optional DD_OS_MESSAGE_ENABLED setting controls the open-source promo banner; and a new deduplication execution mode controls how import/reimport deduplication is dispatched.
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 3.0.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/3.0/): Locations and Asset/Organization labels are now enabled by default; Authorized Users panel replaces Members/Groups under legacy authorization; SSO providers move to DefectDojo Pro; removal of Questionnaire API Endpoints, Credential Manager, and Stub Findings; Dependency Check parser no longer emits separate findings for related dependencies; related file paths are now listed in the main finding's description.
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 2.58.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/2.58/): Notification .tpl templates relocated under dojo/notifications/
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 2.57.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/2.57/): Deprecation of Credential Manager and Stub Findings
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 2.56.4](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/2.56.4/): JFrog Xray API Summary Artifact parser deduplication
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 2.56.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/2.56/): Deprecation of Questionnaire API Endpoints
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 2.55.2](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/2.55.2/): JIRA Reconciliation now also processes Finding Groups.
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 2.55.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/2.55/): Authorization related optimizations
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 2.54.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/2.54/): Removal of django-auditlog & Dropped support for DD_PARSER_EXCLUDE & Reimport performance improvements & Removal of Finding Template Matching
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 2.53.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/2.53/): Helm chart: changes for initializer annotations + Replaced Redis with Valkey + HPA & PDB support + Batch Deduplication
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 2.52.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/2.52/): Replaced Redis with Valkey & Helm chart changes & MobSF parser merge
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 2.51.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/2.51/): Helm chart changes and Postgres major version updates.
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 2.50.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/2.50/): Dropped support for time_zone in System settings.
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 2.49.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/2.49/): No special instructions.
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 2.48.2](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/2.48.2/): Tag invalid character cleanup
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 2.48.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/2.48/): Better pushing to JIRA for Finding Groups
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 2.54.3](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/2.54.3/): Trivy parser deduplication
- [Upgrading to DefectDojo Version 2.47.x](https://docs.defectdojo.com/releases/os_upgrading/2.47/): Drop support for PostgreSQL-HA in HELM
